## Checklist

- [ ] Every line is ≤ 26 cells wide
- [ ] One border family per frame
- [ ] No emoji inside any frame (captions/emoji are outside the fence)
- [ ] Single-cell glyphs only inside aligned regions
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check-width.py` passes locally
